subject: Shiny application works fine with runApp, but breaks with runGitHub

messages.author: f2bae81797a34a4b
messages.subject: Shiny application works fine with runApp, but breaks with runGitHub
parts:
Hello,

I am working on an a Shiny App, DeviumWeb , which launches fine from local file using runApp command. When I try to launch an identical version from GitHub using the command shiny::runGitHub("DeviumWeb", username = "dgrapov") I get the following error:

Error in .Call("R_fromJSON", content, as.integer(sum(simplify)), nullValue,  : 
  "R_fromJSON" not resolved from current namespace (RJSONIO)

What is strange is that after I get this error launching the application using the runApp command will also begin to fail with the same exact error. Reloading the package "RJSONIO" doesn't help. If restart R and launch using runApp every thing works again.
I found a discussion on a similair topic here , but am unsure if this applies to my case and if so, how to implement a fix. 

I have other apps for (e.g. MetaMapR ) using similar schemes, but only DeviumWeb is giving me this headache. I am wondering if any one else has encountered this problem or could suggest what might be causing it?

Thanks in advance,
Dmitry
